gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic opens its small letters wide and stands tall on the line, a plain sans that looks outward. Nordic, with its cramped, closed shapes, is the foil.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Noto Sans Armenian brings full, tall lowercase and generous round letters beneath a heading of bent-paperclip strokes. Over a long passage, Noto Sans Armenian feels approachable and unhurried, easy on the eye.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Nordic draws its horizontals as thick as its verticals, closed and ancient, while the curves of Noto Sans Avestan stop short of touching. Over a longer passage that body reads modern and clean, with a tall x-height.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Stroke by stroke, Nordic looks like bent pipe cleaner, stout and uniform. Noto Sans Balinese does the reverse job, leaving breathing space inside each curve under short ascenders, where Nordic simply hits hard.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Parallel edges run through every curve of Nordic, giving it a drawn-wire stubbornness. And Noto Sans Bamum, with big open counters and curves that stop before turning inward, is where that stubbornness gives way to room.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Noto Sans Bassa Vah reads with a big midsection and open-jawed c. Nordic's pipe-cleaner strokes sit over it, tight and ancient against a sans that has swallowed most of the line's height.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-batak: Noto Sans Batak stands on a towering x-height, with an e that never looks squeezed shut. Noto Sans Batak keeps a long page open and approachable, a sharp release from Nordic's closed forms.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali keeps its capitals barely taller than lowercase, with distinctly open mouths on its letters. Noto Sans Bengali then reads smoothly over many lines, a contrast to the thin-looking, closed strokes of Nordic.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Approachable lowercase, swollen like tightly coiled rope, makes up Noto Sans Bhaiksuki. Beneath Nordic's closed, ancient shapes, its open apertures keep a long stretch of text easy to follow.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Powerful and ancient up top, then open below. Nordic's closed letters give way to Noto Sans Brahmi, whose high mean line and open-ended curves make a quiet counterweight.
